text: consider extended version Basic Structural Time Series Model (BSTSM) describe temperature time series explicit long-term trend, seasonal variability, autoregressive structure. observation equation given yt=αt+vt. y_t = \alpha_t + v_t. \tag{1} , tt denotes time index, yty_t observed temperature, αt\alpha_t latent state, vtv_t observation error. latent state decomposed αt=μt+st+rt+Et. \alpha_t = \mu_t + s_t + r_t + E_t. \tag{2} , μt\mu_t long-term trend component, sts_t seasonal component, rtr_t stationary autoregressive component, EtE_t contribution exogenous variables.

title: Model specification in tempssm
text: level component follows second-order stochastic process: μt=2μt−1−μt−2+ζt,ζt∼𝒩(0,σζ2). \mu_t = 2\mu_{t-1} - \mu_{t-2} + \zeta_t, \qquad \zeta_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_\zeta^2). \tag{3} , ζt\zeta_t process error long-term trend component. formulation allows long-term level rate change vary time.

title: Model specification in tempssm
text: seasonal component modeled sum--zero constraint: st=−∑=t−ft−1si+ωt,ωt∼𝒩(0,σω2). s_t = - \sum_{=t-f}^{t-1} s_i + \omega_t, \qquad \omega_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_\omega^2). \tag{4} , ωt\omega_t process error seasonal component ff denotes seasonal frequency, example f=12f = 12 monthly data. formulation makes seasonal effects identifiable enables models constructed time series different temporal resolutions. imposing sum--zero constraint one complete seasonal cycle, seasonal component captures recurring deviations underlying long-term trend without introducing long-term drift. models without seasonal component, seasonal term sts_t set zero omitted state equation.

title: Model specification in tempssm
text: autoregressive component follows llth-order autoregressive (AR) process: rt=ϕ1rt−1+ϕ2rt−2+⋯+ϕlrt−l+τt,τt∼𝒩(0,στ2). r_t = \phi_1 r_{t-1} + \phi_2 r_{t-2} + \cdots + \phi_l r_{t-l} + \tau_t, \qquad \tau_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_\tau^2). \tag{5} , τt\tau_t denotes process error autoregressive component. process error terms (ζt\zeta_t, ωt\omega_t, τt\tau_t) assumed mutually independent normally distributed. autoregressive component mainly intended absorb remaining short-term serial dependence accounting long-term trend seasonal structure. applied analyses, low-order AR structures often useful starting points, higher orders considered together residual diagnostics prediction performance.

text: Added marginal option select diffuse marginal likelihood consistently KFAS model fitting, likelihood evaluation, summaries, time-series cross-validation. Extended component accessors return either smoothed filtered state estimates. Filtered confidence intervals available, estimates intervals exact diffuse phase reported NA. Added compare_ts_cv() validated comparison collected time-series cross-validation results across candidate models. Added predict.tempssm() forecasts beyond sample period, including models supplied explicit future exogenous values. explicit exo_strategy = "last" option provides simplified one-step persistence forecast using final observed exogenous values. Classified model-fitting messages verbosity routine progress details can controlled options(tempssm.verbosity = ...) TEMPSSM_VERBOSITY environment variable. Added pkgdown site workflow, renamed introductory vignette getting-started, updated package documentation links. Refactored model fitting, cross-validation, forecasting, plotting, time-series utilities focused internal helpers, expanded contract regression tests.
